card.name: "Change in" before lab or weight measures
card.fires_on: The small word 'in' or 'from' right after 'mean change' or 'Change' in clinical trial result tables, just before a measure such as weight, lipids or glucose. Also an opening parenthesis after 'Mean Change from Baseline'.

modes.label: Change in
modes.description: The word 'in' directly after 'mean change' or 'Change' before a measured outcome.
modes.example: The mean change<< in>> weight gain was +0.29

modes.label: Parenthesis after a measure
modes.description: An opening bracket that follows a phrase like 'Mean Change from Baseline' and introduces units or a citation.
modes.example: Mean Change from Baseline<< (>>kg) at Last Visit All Patients +
